sentences.en: His dress betrayed the fact that he was a foreigner.
sentences.zh: 他的穿着泄露了他是个外国人。

sentences.en: He betrayed us by telling the enemy where we were.
sentences.zh: 他把我们的位置告诉了敌人，背叛了我们。

sentences.en: A few words may betray a man's true character.
sentences.zh: 几句话可能暴露一个人的真实性格。

senses.zh: 误导，出卖，背叛，辜负，泄漏
